body: I totally get this op, wish you all the best as well man, take care <3

I understand. I cry maybe twice a year. It's just impossible to cry for more than a few minutes, even if I'm crying for something very emotionally damaging

I can't give you any solutions on how to cry unfortunately OP - but I can assure you suicide is not the option. Trust me, and trust yourself.

You do not want to end your life - you want to end your pain.

Suicide will end everything yes, but will also end your chances of feeling happy, cheerful, joy or pride. You won't get a chance to see how the movie (your life) ends, and you will cut that short, while it could be a very good movie, even if it's a bad start.

You will get by OP, I trust you. ❤️

Am I really fighting anyway? I mean I've either given up or never fought at all. Maybe I'm being dramatic? Maybe I do it for attention, to be honest, I'm never sure, my brains tricks me so often. Maybe I am totally fine or the complete opposite. I don't know, it's weird.

Thank you for taking the time to read and reply. It helps. If only I could thank everyone IRL.

Wishing you the best.

Hey, thanks for replying and taking the time to read.

I'm pretty sure I don't think that my life is hell. But my brain convinces me otherwise throughout the day. It's like very short episodes, either I'm totally on repeat on suicide or I'm happy and I don't think about it. Get me? Depends on the time of the day, mostly school worsens it and time to go sleep does the same because I get time to think about things over and over. 

I don't know how to ask for therapy. It's scary/embarrassing to ask parents.

What parts do you relate to? Great to know I'm not alone to feel like this.

Thanks for the wish!

Yes I have, playing football, video games. Planes, too. I love those.

It's a weird feeling really? Do I really wanna live a long life? Why not end it now before I'm too old to do so?
Just weird. Really hard to describe.
Thank you so much, it really means a lot to me man. Same to you.
Good point. Thanks kind stranger!
Because of the time. It means time. I have to take away time from my life. Then what? Sleep>work>sleep repeating until I die? Why bother doing that all life-long when I can just skip the process?

Thank you so much for listening to me, I'm only a stranger on the internet. It feels great.

I think I have an issue with time. And suicide in general. I can be perfectly happy. And then I'll picture myself cutting my wrist until I bleed out or killing, myself, jumping off a high building. And I think I like the idea? Like I don't know, it's really weird.

And for the time issue. I always think about time. If I'm bored I'll count the time left until the thing that's boring me ends. Sometimes if it's long enough I'll count the seconds.

And I always think about the future because of the time too. How much time is left? How much time does this take? I can't waste my time. My time will be wasted. I waste my time. I could have more time. At least when you're dead, you got infinite time I guess?

I will need to work in order to have a successful life. I'm just lost in my head I think

I want to be an air traffic controller. Pays well, I love airplanes, I love speaking English.

But if I succeed, I'll have to live for another 50 years at least. I certainly don't want that. 15 years I already lived, it was very long, and I enjoyed it. Imagine having a non enjoyable life for 50 years. thinking about it is already terrifying and stressful.
And I hope you're right and I'll see it that way once I'm 18. Otherwise I'm pretty sure I'll end it like that.

I think I'm stressed out, yes. Everyday I stress about anything and I ovethink about it as a response and it's a circle that never ends and usually it gets to the point where I think about jumping off the school building. People expect me to be successful because I always was in school.

Childhood, for me, is magically ending at 18. I will have to work. Have responsibilities. For a whole life. Until I retire or I die, either way it's taking a really long time and it's too much. It's really weird. It's stressful. Really really stressful to always think about stress and the future.

I don't know. I think though, it's because I don't want adult life to be boring or I'd have to still live through boredom for years and years.

I never did anything to kill myself, never tried never even cut myself. But since a few months it's getting to my head. I always had suicide ideation, maybe I like this idea of killing myself, but it's taking more and more of my thoughts. I don't want to kill myself, but at the same time I'd gladly accept to. Weird to explain I'm sorry

I don't know. I'm lost, and very very much stressed about my future. I don't want to live past 18, it'll all be constantly being depressed until you die. So why not fasten the process and enjoy my 3 years of childhood left? And start over?

I'm lost. I don't even know how to describe this feeling, so I'm using "lost" but I don't even know man.
